title: Read a feature straight off the graph
subtitle: Nonlinear functions · 22 official questions

sections.heading: Where this sits for you
body: **22 of the official questions in Nonlinear functions are this one** — 19 Easy, 3 Medium, 0 Hard.
It is bottom-heavy, which makes it cheap points. Secure it early.

sections.heading: How to spot it
body: You are looking at this pattern when:
- There is a graph and no equation.
- You're asked for its y-intercept, vertex, maximum or minimum, and the answer is a coordinate pair or a single number.

sections.heading: The method
body: - 1) Name the feature: the y-intercept is where x = 0, and the vertex is the highest or lowest turning point.
- 2) Follow the gridlines to that point and read both coordinates, counting the scale on each axis.

sections.heading: Where Desmos fits
body: There is no equation to enter, and reading the grid is faster.

sections.heading: What it is built to catch
body: You swap the coordinates, read the x-intercept when asked for the y-intercept, or misread an axis scale that goes up in 2s, 5s or 10s.

sections.heading: You are losing these
body: Before you choose, say out loud what the question is asking for — not what you solved for.
